name: Citizenship by Marriage

requirements.blocker_text: A spouse of a Venezuelan citizen who has been married to and living in Venezuela with that citizen for 5 continuous years may naturalize. No gender distinction between husband and wife was found in the source reviewed -- applied equally to either spouse.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 continuous years of marriage and cohabitation in Venezuela with the citizen spouse, then apply.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous cohabitation in Venezuela

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 5 years continuous residence in Venezuela with the spouse

sources.title: Wikipedia -- marriage-based naturalization: 5 continuous years married and resident in Venezuela with the citizen spouse
